name: China Enterprise Company Limited
summary: China Enterprise Company Limited engages in real estate development and operational activities in China. The company is involved in commercial housing design, construction, leasing, and sales activities. The company also offers group catering and food delivery services, and engages in municipal infrastructure investment, land reclamation, and related activities. China Enterprise Company Limited was founded in 1954 and is based in Shanghai, China. China Enterprise Company Limited is a subsidiary of Shanghai Real Estate (Group) Co., Ltd.
